::: {.research-areas}

## Research Areas

::: {.area-cards}

::: {.area-card data-topics="experimental-design field-experiment causal-inference"}
[Experimental Design & Causal Inference]{.area-title}

Designing more powerful experiments — blocking algorithms, sequential and field designs, and politically-robust designs — and the causal inference methods that connect them to politics and policy evaluation

[Show related work →]{.area-link}
:::

::: {.area-card data-topics="social-policy housing-policy public-safety public-health economic-security"}
[Social & Public Policy]{.area-title}

How social and public policy works, and how it gets made: randomized and observational studies, several with [The Lab @ DC](https://thelab.dc.gov), plus research on public-health access and direct democracy

[Show related work →]{.area-link}
:::

::: {.area-card data-topics="geolocation political-behavior interest-groups policymaking"}
[Place, Geography, & Political Behavior]{.area-title}

Political behavior and the contexts that shape it — using fine-grained geographic data to define racial and ethnic context, and studying interest groups, policymaking, direct democracy, and political activity online

[Show related work →]{.area-link}
:::

::: {.area-card data-topics="r-software pedagogy"}
[Statistical Software & Pedagogy]{.area-title}

Reproducible computation in social science — R packages for blocking, ecological inference, scraping HTML, and working with LaTeX — and teaching quantitative methods

[Show related work →]{.area-link}
:::

:::

:::

```{=html}
<script>
(function(){
  function init(){
    const lists = document.querySelectorAll('.pub-list');
    if (!lists.length) return;
    const filterContainer = document.querySelector('.topic-filter');
    if (!filterContainer) return;

    // Discover topic vocabulary from per-entry tags
    const vocab = {};
    document.querySelectorAll('.pub-list .topic-tag').forEach(t => {
      const slug = t.dataset.topic;
      if (!slug) return;
      vocab[slug] = (t.textContent || '').trim();
    });

    // Build the filter bar
    filterContainer.innerHTML = '';
    const label = document.createElement('span');
    label.className = 'topic-filter-label';
    label.textContent = 'Filter by topic:';
    filterContainer.appendChild(label);

    const chipsRow = document.createElement('span');
    chipsRow.className = 'topic-filter-chips';
    Object.keys(vocab)
      .sort((a,b) => vocab[a].localeCompare(vocab[b]))
      .forEach(slug => {
        const chip = document.createElement('button');
        chip.type = 'button';
        chip.className = 'topic-filter-chip';
        chip.dataset.topic = slug;
        chip.textContent = vocab[slug];
        chip.addEventListener('click', () => toggleTopic(slug));
        chipsRow.appendChild(chip);
      });
    filterContainer.appendChild(chipsRow);

    const status = document.createElement('span');
    status.className = 'topic-filter-status';
    filterContainer.appendChild(status);

    const clearBtn = document.createElement('button');
    clearBtn.type = 'button';
    clearBtn.className = 'topic-filter-clear';
    clearBtn.textContent = 'Clear';
    clearBtn.addEventListener('click', () => setActive([]));
    filterContainer.appendChild(clearBtn);

    // Click handlers on per-entry chips
    document.querySelectorAll('.pub-list .topic-tag').forEach(t => {
      t.setAttribute('role', 'button');
      t.setAttribute('tabindex', '0');
      t.addEventListener('click', () => toggleTopic(t.dataset.topic));
      t.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
        if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') {
          e.preventDefault();
          toggleTopic(t.dataset.topic);
        }
      });
    });

    // Click handlers on Research Areas cards
    document.querySelectorAll('.area-card').forEach(card => {
      const topics = (card.dataset.topics || '').split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
      if (!topics.length) return;
      card.setAttribute('role', 'button');
      card.setAttribute('tabindex', '0');
      const handler = () => {
        setActive(topics);
        filterContainer.scrollIntoView({behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start'});
      };
      card.addEventListener('click', handler);
      card.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
        if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') {
          e.preventDefault();
          handler();
        }
      });
    });

    let active = [];

    function toggleTopic(slug){
      if (!slug) return;
      active = active.includes(slug)
        ? active.filter(s => s !== slug)
        : [...active, slug];
      apply();
      syncURL();
    }
    function setActive(arr){
      active = (arr || []).filter(s => vocab[s]);
      apply();
      syncURL();
    }
    function apply(){
      // Chip visual state
      filterContainer.querySelectorAll('.topic-filter-chip').forEach(c => {
        c.classList.toggle('is-active', active.includes(c.dataset.topic));
      });
      document.querySelectorAll('.topic-tag').forEach(t => {
        t.classList.toggle('is-active', active.includes(t.dataset.topic));
      });
      // Card highlight
      document.querySelectorAll('.area-card').forEach(card => {
        const topics = (card.dataset.topics || '').split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
        const allMatch = topics.length && topics.every(t => active.includes(t));
        card.classList.toggle('is-active', !!allMatch);
      });

      // Filter entries
      let shown = 0, total = 0;
      lists.forEach(list => {
        const items = list.querySelectorAll(':scope > ul > li, :scope li');
        // Avoid double-counting nested li by selecting only direct list items
        const directItems = list.querySelectorAll(':scope > ul > li');
        const targetItems = directItems.length ? directItems : items;
        targetItems.forEach(li => {
          total++;
          const tags = Array.from(li.querySelectorAll('.topic-tag'))
            .map(t => t.dataset.topic);
          const match = active.length === 0 || active.some(a => tags.includes(a));
          li.style.display = match ? '' : 'none';
          if (match) shown++;
        });
      });

      // Hide empty section headings (h2/h3) when their list has no visible items
      document.querySelectorAll('h2, h3').forEach(h => {
        let next = h.nextElementSibling;
        while (next && next.tagName !== 'H2' && next.tagName !== 'H3') {
          if (next.classList && (next.classList.contains('pub-list') || next.querySelector?.('.pub-list'))) {
            const targetList = next.classList.contains('pub-list')
              ? next
              : next.querySelector('.pub-list');
            const directItems = targetList.querySelectorAll(':scope > ul > li');
            const visible = Array.from(directItems).filter(li => li.style.display !== 'none').length;
            const empty = active.length > 0 && directItems.length > 0 && visible === 0;
            h.style.display = empty ? 'none' : '';
            // Also hide reports-note when reports list is empty
            const note = h.parentElement?.querySelector('.reports-note');
            if (note && note.parentElement === h.parentElement) {
              note.style.display = empty ? 'none' : '';
            }
            return;
          }
          next = next.nextElementSibling;
        }
      });

      if (active.length === 0) {
        status.textContent = '';
        filterContainer.classList.remove('has-active');
      } else {
        status.textContent = 'Showing ' + shown + ' of ' + total;
        filterContainer.classList.add('has-active');
      }
    }
    function syncURL(){
      const url = new URL(window.location);
      if (active.length === 0) {
        url.searchParams.delete('topic');
      } else {
        url.searchParams.set('topic', active.join(','));
      }
      window.history.replaceState({}, '', url);
    }
    function readURL(){
      const url = new URL(window.location);
      const param = url.searchParams.get('topic');
      if (param) {
        setActive(param.split(',').map(s => s.trim()));
      }
    }

    readURL();
  }

  if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', init);
  } else {
    init();
  }
})();
</script>

<script>
// Deep-link handler: Quarto sets body padding-top inside DOMContentLoaded,
// which shifts layout *after* the browser's initial fragment scroll. For
// inline span anchors (vs heading sections), Quarto's :target offset rule
// doesn't apply, so the target ends up hidden under the navbar. Re-scroll
// ourselves after layout settles, and flash the surrounding entry.
(function(){
  function navHeight(){
    const h = document.querySelector('header.fixed-top');
    return h ? h.offsetHeight : 60;
  }
  function focusHashTarget(){
    if (!location.hash) return;
    const id = decodeURIComponent(location.hash.slice(1));
    const el = document.getElementById(id);
    if (!el) return;
    // Wait two frames: one for Quarto's body padding-top to apply,
    // one for the browser to settle layout.
    requestAnimationFrame(() => requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      const rect = el.getBoundingClientRect();
      const top = rect.top + window.pageYOffset - navHeight() - 16;
      window.scrollTo({ top: Math.max(0, top), behavior: 'auto' });
      const flashTarget = el.closest('.pub-list > ul > li') || el;
      flashTarget.classList.remove('pub-target-flash'); // restart animation
      void flashTarget.offsetWidth;
      flashTarget.classList.add('pub-target-flash');
    }));
  }
  window.addEventListener('load', focusHashTarget);
  window.addEventListener('hashchange', focusHashTarget);
})();
</script>
```
